name: url-shortener-core
scope: The whole spec. Owns every operation of the UrlShortener protocol (src protocol.clj) and all state named by role in README.md and test-resources/IMPLICIT_SPEC.md: the link entity, its per-request create outcomes, and its lifetime deduplicated click count. All requirements, bounds, workloads, and edge cases bind by reference to those files; nothing is restated here.
